sources.title: Embassy of Panama: immigration and visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Panamanian Government embassy immigration page publishes a named no-visa visitor-country list and includes Qatar, separately from conditional third-country visa or residence routes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: No Visa RequireD: IF you are from any of the following countries ... Qatar

sources.title: Visa regime of Kazakhstan for foreign citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Kazakhstan
sources.officialityEvidence: Kazakhstan MFA's current passport-type table has separate diplomatic, service/official and ordinary columns and gives Qatar's ordinary-passport rule.

sources.title: Mongolia Electronic Visa Application System
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government Immigration Agency eVisa system includes Qatar in its eligible-country list and states that an eVisa is received after applying and paying online.
sources.supportingExcerpt: In 3 Steps your evisa is ready! 1. Apply 2. Pay 3. Receive Visa ... Qatar

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy immigration guidance names Qatar in its no-visa visitor-country list for stays of up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Qatari passport holder, visitor stay of up to three months; carry the stated passport validity, return/onward travel and funds where requested.
Employment, residence, transit, conditional third-country visa or residence routes, special passports and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Kazakhstan short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA's current passport-type table lists Qatari ordinary passports as visa-free for up to 30 days.
conditions: Ordinary Qatari passport holder, visa-free stay of up to 30 days under the current Kazakhstan MFA table.
Work, residence, longer stays, diplomatic, service/official and other special-document routes remain separate.

policies.title: Qatari ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's current Immigration Agency eVisa system lists Qatar and describes electronic visa issuance after the online application and payment steps.
conditions: Use an ordinary Qatari passport accepted by Mongolia's current eVisa system; apply, pay and receive the issued visa before travel.

Tourism and other visitor-purpose, passport-validity, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate. Residence, work, invitation-based and border-issued routes are not established by this policy.

application.label: Mongolia Electronic Visa Application System
steps: Apply online with the ordinary Qatari passport and pay the prescribed fee.
Receive the issued eVisa before travel and carry it for border processing.

conflicts.explanation: Mongolia's current Immigration Agency system expressly includes Qatar in its eVisa-country list and describes completed online issuance. This is electronic issuance before travel, not an online request followed by border issuance.
